215.s: His wife helps with his career and handles business and mail.

232.t: Bernice's support and trust while he travelled
232.s: She backed him when the Hammond contract came and never worried about his road life, and welcomed every friend.
232.q: this Hammond deal came; that was 1939. Again, she was very impressive when I went and talked to him about the contract and everything, and she said, you had the horn when I met you and I wish you luck, but whether it's good or bad you'll never have to say that I kept you from trying.
